what: Once the page end is near (when the end marker enters the screen), the whole body panel recedes to .935x (phone .895) around a pivot 50lvh down, fades to .75 and its bottom corners shrink (.25s ease-out-quad) — revealing the footer stuck behind it. The panel’s immediate sibling (the footer) fades in from transparent over .25s at the same time. To make it recede in the same state as when the contact panel opens, attach is-receded to the panel directly

options.lead: How far in front of the panel’s bottom edge to put the end marker (px), default 200 — the original is four margins’ worth (desktop) or twelve (phone)
options.--fx-radius: Normal bottom corner (style), default 24px — when it steps back, --fx-radius-in (default 10px)
options.[data-fx-part=end]: End marker (optional) — if absent, a 1px marker is created behind the board and pulled up by lead
options.is-receded: Marker attached to the panel while it is pulled back — the following sibling footer uses [data-fx~=selected with recede-footer].is-receded + *

note: The panel sits on top (z-index) and the footer stays stuck behind it with sticky bottom so it is revealed as the panel moves away. The panel needs a background color

from.where: shared.js·shared.css .fg-wrap > main (original Wrapper[data-footer] main: scale .935 · phone .895, opacity .75, bottom corner margin → margin×.4, transition all .25s ease-out-quad, transform-origin center calc(100% − 50lvh)) · opening the Contact panel triggers the same recession over .5s (up to the top corners)
